items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-103849, CVE-2026-92909, and multiple Cross-site Scripting issues.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0), also known as StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. It was under active exploitation before a hotfix was released.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and Incorrect Authorization (CVE-2026-77111, CVE-2026-77109, CVE-2026-77774, CVE-2026-76202) flaws, and a Path Traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-77110). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: This bulletin fixes seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data. It has a CVSS score of 9.1.
